assignment: Characterize extremal boundary/degenerate configurations necessary for the global deduction; a nonmonomial stationary point or maximizer is not alone a counterexample.

consumed_other_account_results.use: Rules out requiring final convex weights to preserve P=|U|^2 even when the determinant remains inside the MOC4 hull.
Closes repeated-spectrum and common-reducing-block boundary regimes.
Supplies exact support reduction to the structured mixed assignment inequality in the actual unitary-derived P,R variables.

new_result.theorem: If MOC4 has any counterexample, then arbitrarily near it there is a counterexample with simple nonzero spectra, pairwise-distinct 24 permutation products, no zero 1x1 or 2x2 unitary minors, distinct squared singular values for every 2x2 compression, no common nontrivial reducing subspace, a strictly positive support gap, and a unique maximizing permutation vertex.
new_result.consequence: It suffices to prove the B07 mixed assignment inequality only on this generic strict-support locus; degenerate spectral/unitary strata cannot be the sole location of a genuine failure.

remaining_obligation: MOC4-MIXED-ASSIGNMENT-GENERIC-v1: prove the structured mixed assignment inequality for generic U, simple nonzero complex spectra, and support directions with a unique maximizing permutation.
